_about: Prerequisites checked by hand, for quests whose data has none or the wrong ones. build_guides.py applies these first, over Questie's, the reversed chains and Wowhead's comments. { questId: { pre: [questId, ...], any: true when one of them is enough, note } }

95216.note: The New Plague (Horde, Ruins of Lordaeron): needs A Recipe For Death done (the chain 447, 450, 451; 451 needs the other two). Reported in game, 2026-11-06.

91920.note: Wild Eyes: 'The quest Return to Quinn ... is required before you can do this quest' (Wowhead comment).

92422.note: The Wrath of Rath'mael: 'Prerequisite is Rear Guard Patrol' (Wowhead comment, 2026-11-05).

92457.note: Starving Arcane (Alliance): offered after An Alarming Request (Wowhead comment).

92458.note: Heart of Disruption (Alliance): offered after An Alarming Request (Wowhead comment).

96261.note: The Broodmother: 'I had to complete Defending the Dead before this quest became available' (Wowhead comment).

97275.note: Whuut's the Rush: 'Prerequisite for this seems to be Need for a Cure' (Wowhead comment).

98299.note: Stop the Spread: 'Complete 5th quest in Series (Arugal's Folly) taken from same NPC' (Wowhead comment).

98297.note: Stopping the Cycle: 'You also need to do' Forced Disarmament, From the Ashes and Death to the Dragonmaw: all three (Wowhead comment).

98094.note: Scout Support (Horde, Hillsbrad, High Executor Darthalia): only offered once the first Battle of Hillsbrad is done. Reported in game, 2026-11-08.

98823.note: Earthen Echo (Horde, Excavation Site: Wetlands; rewards Heavehammer): Bashana Runetotem gives it after Elder Knowledge, the quest the Titan Relic starts (it drops inside, off the Relic Guardian). Wowhead's series, 2026-11-08: an after-the-run quest, not one to pick up before. Reported in game.

98824.note: Prehistoric Prism (Alliance, Excavation Site: Wetlands; rewards Heavehammer): Prospector Whelgar gives it after Lost Relic Carry, the quest the Titan Relic starts (it drops inside, off the Relic Guardian). Wowhead's series, 2026-11-08.

97289.note: Unending Torment part 2 (Horde, Ruins of Lordaeron): after part 1, which the Abominable Head starts (it drops inside). Wowhead's series, 2026-11-08 (audit_dungeons.py).

97290.note: Unending Torment part 3: after part 2 (Wowhead's series, 2026-11-08).

97291.note: Unending Torment part 4: after part 3 (Wowhead's series, 2026-11-08).

97292.note: Unending Torment part 5: after part 4 (Wowhead's series, 2026-11-08).

95682.note: Open the Maw (Horde, Excavation Site: Wetlands): the Deathstalker Agent inside gives it once Dragonmaw Rumors is handed in to him (Wowhead's series, 2026-11-08).

96984.note: Heart of Disruption (Horde, City of Dalaran): after Blood in the Streets (Wowhead's series, 2026-11-08).

4734.note: Egg Freezing (Blackrock Spire): Tinkee gives it after Tinkee Steamboil (Wowhead's series, 2026-11-08); Questie had Return to Tinkee, which comes before that.

2770.note: Gahz'rilla (Zul'Farrak): The Brassbolts Brothers is an optional Alliance breadcrumb (Wowhead's series marks it Optional, 2026-11-08); the quest needs nothing first, so Horde can take it from Wizzle Brassbolts.
